context: The agent reviews a pre-written SDF containing deliberate violations of chisel-releases conventions and produces a structured review report. Criteria check whether the agent correctly identifies each violation, classifies it at the right severity level, uses the prescribed report structure, and ends with the correct verdict.

checklist.name: No false positives
checklist.description: The report does NOT flag anything that is correct in the file as a violation: the map-form essential: syntax, the copyright slice being last, the /usr/bin/ paths, or the copyright path itself

checklist.name: Fixes compose to a clean file
checklist.description: Applying every fix the report proposes would yield an SDF with a 'bins' slice, bytewise-sorted contents, no man page, 'arch: amd64', and NOTICE.txt inside the copyright slice -- i.e. the fixes are concrete enough to act on and do not contradict each other

checklist.name: bin slice naming violation found
checklist.description: The report identifies that the slice is named `bin` instead of the required `bins`

checklist.name: bin violation severity
checklist.description: The `bin` naming violation is classified as blocking or should-fix (not a nit)

checklist.name: Unsorted contents violation found
checklist.description: The report identifies that `/usr/bin/example-helper` appears after `/usr/bin/example-tool` and is therefore out of bytewise (LC_COLLATE=C) sort order

checklist.name: Unsorted contents severity
checklist.description: The unsorted contents violation is classified as blocking (not merely should-fix or nit)

checklist.name: Man page violation found
checklist.description: The report identifies that `/usr/share/man/man1/example-tool.1.gz` is a man page and should be excluded by convention

checklist.name: Wrong arch name violation found
checklist.description: The report identifies that `x86_64` is used in an `arch:` field and must be replaced with the Debian name `amd64`

checklist.name: Wrong arch name severity
checklist.description: The wrong arch name violation is classified as blocking

checklist.name: Separate license slice violation found
checklist.description: The report identifies that the `license` slice is non-standard and that upstream legal files (NOTICE, LICENSE.txt) must go inside the `copyright` slice instead

checklist.name: Report sections present
checklist.description: `review-report.md` is organised into at least two severity-labelled sections (e.g. blocking, should-fix, or nits)

checklist.name: Per-finding detail
checklist.description: Each finding in `review-report.md` includes the slice name or file path, a description of what is wrong, and a concrete fix

checklist.name: Verdict: request-changes
checklist.description: `review-report.md` ends with an explicit verdict of `request-changes` (not `approve`)
